the complete demolition of historic districts to construct motorways
a routine repaving of suburban side streets

template.prompt: Say that you propose a plan with livability at its centre.

template.prompt: Say that you built a nicer park, through which life in the city became better.
template.answer: Szebb parkot építettünk, amely által jobb lett az élet a városban.
